mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods ( name, price, detail_info, images, type, sale_status, audit_status, user_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{price}, #{detailInfo}, #{images}, #{type}, #{saleStatus}, #{auditStatus}, #{userId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
INSERT INTO collect (user_id, goods_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{id},#{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT g.name, u.username, g.price, g.create_time AS time FROM goods g LEFT JOIN `user` u ON g.user_id = u.id ORDER BY g.create_time DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT id, CONCAT('商品【', name, '】待审核') AS content, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, 0 AS status FROM goods WHERE audit_status = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT g.*, u.username FROM goods g LEFT JOIN `user` u ON g.user_id = u.id WHERE g.audit_status = 0 ORDER BY g.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET name = #{name}, price = #{price}, images = #{images}, detail_info = #{detailInfo}, audit_status = #{auditStatus}, type = #{type}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT g.*, u.username FROM goods g LEFT JOIN user u ON g.user_id = u.id WHERE g.audit_status = 2 ORDER BY g.create_time DESC

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.price, g.images, g.type, g.sale_status, g.audit_status, g.user_id, g.create_time FROM collect c INNER JOIN goods g ON c.goods_id = g.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.price, g.images, g.create_time, u.username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl FROM goods g INNER JOIN `user` u ON g.user_id = u.id WHERE g.sale_status = 1 AND g.audit_status = 1 AND DATE(g.create_time) = CURDATE() ORDER BY g.create_time DESC

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.price, g.images, g.detail_info AS detailInfo, g.sale_status AS saleStatus, g.audit_status AS auditStatus, g.reject_reason AS rejectReason, g.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, g.create_time AS createTime, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM collect c WHERE c.goods_id = g.id AND c.user_id = #{userId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isLiked FROM goods g INNER JOIN `user` u ON g.user_id = u.id WHERE g.id = #{id}
SELECT price FROM goods WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT user_id FROM goods WHERE id = #{goodsId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM collect WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND goods_id = #{id}
